# Citus comparison

Advertised Citus configurations. No Citus deployment has been executed by the comparative benchmark runner.

Every comparative result published before 2026-11-01 was withdrawn: the records are retained as forensic evidence and the reasons are recorded in the append-only [invalidation ledger](../../data/tidb-comparison/invalidations.ndjson); each entry (inv-NNNN) names the withdrawn records, the admission reason codes and the defect ids (DNN) behind the withdrawal.

![Citus comparison](citus-comparison-progress.svg)

## Cell status vocabulary

- `valid-observed`: admitted from retained v2 observations
- `product-failure`: the product ran and failed; failure counts are shown
- `invalid-measurement`: evidence exists but cannot support the claim (reason codes name why)
- `blocked`: cannot be measured until a named prerequisite exists
- `unsupported`: the configuration cannot express this claim
- `not-measured`: no observation exists
